description: Work with Passbolt through a Passbolt user of the agent's own, within rules you set.
long_description: Find credentials, use them without seeing them, rotate and share them. The agent works through a Passbolt user of its own, sees only what is shared with it, and never sees a secret unless the configuration says so.
name: passbolt-mcp

tools.description: Comment on a resource, as the MCP user.
tools.name: add_comment

tools.description: Call an API of the configuration, passbolt-mcp adding the secret to the request: the agent never sees it, and the answer comes back with the secret taken out. `whoami` lists the APIs.
tools.name: call_api

tools.description: Whether the password of a resource is in a known breach, by k-anonymity: only the first five characters of its SHA-1 leave, to Have I Been Pwned.
tools.name: check_password_pwned

tools.description: Create a folder; in a parent folder, it gets the permissions of the parent.
tools.name: create_folder

tools.description: Create a resource, its secret encrypted for the MCP user; in a folder, it gets the permissions of the folder.
tools.name: create_resource

tools.description: Delete a comment the MCP user wrote on a resource.
tools.name: delete_comment

tools.description: Delete a folder, for everyone it is shared with; with `with_content`, its subfolders and resources too. Try it with `dry_run` first.
tools.name: delete_folder

tools.description: Delete a resource, for everyone it is shared with. Try it with `dry_run` first.
tools.name: delete_resource

tools.description: Fill a template of the configuration: passbolt-mcp reads the file the agent wrote, puts each secret where `{{ passbolt:<resource id> }}`, `{{ passbolt:<resource id>#<field> }}` or a handle stands, and writes the target, which the agent cannot read. `whoami` lists the templates.
tools.name: fill_template

tools.description: The folders the agent can see, as a tree.
tools.name: folder_tree

tools.description: A new password, passphrase or PIN code, following the password policy of the organization unless asked otherwise, with its strength; saved nowhere.
tools.name: generate_password

tools.description: Who has access to a resource or a folder, and how.
tools.name: get_permissions

tools.description: A resource: name, username, URIs, description, folder, dates. Never its secret.
tools.name: get_resource

tools.description: One field of the secret of a resource: its password by default.
tools.name: get_secret

tools.description: The current TOTP code of a resource, or a handle to it; never its seed.
tools.name: get_totp_code

tools.description: The comments on a resource, oldest first.
tools.name: list_comments

tools.description: The folders the agent can see, with their paths.
tools.name: list_folders

tools.description: The resource types of the server: what a resource can hold.
tools.name: list_resource_types

tools.description: The resources the agent can see, with their names: never their secrets.
tools.name: list_resources

tools.description: Move a folder, with its content, into another folder of the scope.
tools.name: move_folder

tools.description: Move a resource to another folder of the scope.
tools.name: move_resource

tools.description: Rename a folder.
tools.name: rename_folder

tools.description: Run a command of the configuration with a password in its environment, which the agent never sees: what the command prints comes back with the password taken out. `whoami` lists the commands.
tools.name: run_with_secret

tools.description: Users and groups to share with.
tools.name: search_aros

tools.description: Mark a resource as a favorite of the MCP user, or unmark it.
tools.name: set_favorite

tools.description: Share a folder with users and groups, or revoke their access; the MCP user must own it. With `with_content` (the default), also on what it owns inside.
tools.name: share_folder

tools.description: Share a resource with users and groups, or revoke their access; the MCP user must own it. Those who gain access get the secret, encrypted for them.
tools.name: share_resource

tools.description: Show one field of the secret of a resource to the person, in the client: the agent never sees it. For when the person needs the password itself.
tools.name: show_secret

tools.description: Who would get access to a resource if it were shared so, group members included; shares nothing.
tools.name: simulate_share

tools.description: Change the fields given of a resource; a new secret is encrypted for everyone with access.
tools.name: update_resource

tools.description: The Passbolt user this server acts as, and what its rules allow.
tools.name: whoami

config.description: passbolt-mcp.toml: the Passbolt server, the MCP user and the rules. See the quick start.
config.title: Configuration
